messages.subject: Linear constraint
parts:
Hi Dr Chalmers,

I got a question about your paper (mirt: A Multidimensional Item Response Theory Package for the R) about linear constraint. I am confused by your equation 18, 19, and 20. They seems not compatible to the equations in Cai Li's paper (p. 322, http://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.3102/1076998609353115)

1. Are both paper using same constraint method?
2. I wonder how do you implement it in mirt package with those in your paper, given that you are using optim() with BFGS optimizer?

I hope this is the appropriate place to ask you about the papers. Thanks!
